June 7, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Lvm Capital Management Ltd increased its stake in Exxon Mobil (XOM) by 33.99% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lvm Capital Management Ltd bought 33,716 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.16% with the market. The institutional investor held 132,896 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $9.92M, up from 99,180 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lvm Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Exxon Mobil for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $347.43 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.71% or $1.38 during the last trading session, reaching $82.06. About 11.60 million shares traded. Exxon Mobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) has declined 3.72% since June 7, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.29% the S&P500.
